evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Decode-time steering then lifts keyword recall from 16.6% to 20.7% at no accuracy cost and negligible overhead; most of the gain comes from an n-gram over ordinary training transcripts, which resolves the written form of code-switched words the model hears but spells inconsistently, with phrase boosting adding targeted control over rare domain terms.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across two Thai benchmarks and two model sizes, the streaming models stay usable where the full-context model fails, cutting character error rate 4.3-4.5x at a one-second look-ahead while running faster than real time.
